summary.en: Discover and open Settings pages and manage owner-scoped App permission requests and revocations through the OS.

why.en: Read account details for the optional Users page through the OS.
Apply explicitly requested account changes through the OS; the Settings window can open without this permission.
Inspect and request or revoke App permissions for this owner; protected OS approval remains separate.
Read system locale, keyboard defaults and this owner's account language through the OS.
Apply an explicitly selected system locale through the OS; owner language is a separate permission.
Apply this authenticated owner's account language through the OS.
Apply an explicitly entered static computer name through the OS.
Apply the separately requested system/login keyboard defaults; owner typing settings never imply this permission.
Apply explicitly selected system timezone and automatic-time changes through the OS.
Read accessibility state through the existing OS provider, without the owner bus.
Apply explicitly requested screen-reader, magnifier and screen-filter changes through the OS.
Read the owner's audio devices, profiles, routes, defaults and volume through the existing OS provider.
Change the selected output's volume, balance or mute through the OS, without a PipeWire socket.
Change the selected microphone's volume or mute through the OS; output control does not grant this.
Apply explicit audio-default, hardware-profile and route choices through the OS.
Read the owner's display modes and output metadata through the existing OS provider.
Apply explicit output changes and owner-bound OS rollback receipts, without a raw output-management connection.
Query city-level location through the OS only while owner automatic light/dark switching is enabled; never expose the owner bus.
Read NetworkManager metadata through the OS; never expose its bus or secrets.
Apply explicit wired profile and connection choices through the OS independently of wireless/VPN rights.
Apply Wi-Fi profile, connection and radio choices through the OS; credentials retain their own exact read check.
Import bounded data-only VPN configurations and apply explicit VPN profile/connection choices, never executable hooks.
Apply an explicit all-radio airplane choice independently of Wi-Fi, VPN or Bluetooth control.
Ask Root to use an explicitly entered network/name credential reference; Settings never receives that vault password.
Explicitly export the selected saved Wi-Fi profile password for its original QR sharing UI, with an exact profile UUID check at Root.
Read Bluetooth adapters and devices through the existing Root provider.
Apply explicit Bluetooth power, discovery, pairing, connection and removal choices through the OS, not the system bus.
Read the exact OS Bluetooth unit status; device observation does not grant service management.
Start or enable the exact Bluetooth unit only on explicit request, without App-owned polkit.
Read battery/device state and available OS power profile state through the existing Root provider.
Apply an explicitly selected OS power profile; this does not authorize shutdown, suspend, reboot or another App.
Read this owner's compositor, keyboard and pointing-device preferences through the bounded OS service.
Read only this owner's two standard custom XKB catalog files. Public system XKB catalogs need no owner-file grant.
Save this owner's compositor and input preferences, not system keyboard defaults or a configuration-tree mount.
Read this owner's desktop workspace presentation preferences.
Save this owner's desktop workspace presentation preferences.
Read this owner's toolkit, theme and theme-builder preferences.
Save this owner's toolkit and desktop appearance preferences through the OS.
Read this owner's panel and dock configuration, without an owner bus or file mount.
Save this owner's panel, dock and selected applet configuration; installation and App permissions stay separate.
Read this owner's screen-off and idle-suspend preferences.
Save this owner's screen-off and idle-suspend preferences, not issue power actions.
Read this owner's audio preference values; live audio controls require separate device permissions.
Save this owner's volume-amplification preferences, not acquire audio or microphone control.
Read this owner's settings-daemon accessibility preferences.
Save this owner's mono-audio preference through the OS settings service.
Read this owner's clock-format and first-weekday preferences.
Save this owner's clock presentation; system time and timezone require separate OS permission.
Read this owner's keyboard shortcuts and configured command bindings.
Configure owner keyboard shortcuts, including commands run when the owner activates a binding. This is not permission to execute a command now.
Read this owner's window-management rules.
Save this owner's window-management rules through the OS.
Read this owner's desktop background configuration and current background metadata, not image contents.
Save this owner's desktop background choices; no owner directory or selected-file permission is granted.
Read this owner's ordered regional-language preferences.
Save only this owner's ordered language preference list; system locale and account language remain separate effects.
Read only exact resources already delegated by this launcher's bounded file authority. A file-picker result is metadata, never a read grant.
Export a theme only within this launcher's existing bounded write authority. The picker cannot grant or widen file access.
Present the original OS file chooser for this live Settings window. Its metadata-only result grants no file access or account authority.

summary.en: List installed verified Apps visible to this owner, with quarantine errors. Does not grant their permissions.

why.en: Inspect and manage owner-scoped App permission policy through the OS; never approve grants.

label.en: List installed verified Apps visible to this owner, with quarantine errors. Does not grant their permissions.

summary.en: Show declared permissions, owner/App enablement, current daemon grants, unsupported direct-resource permissions, and pending/recent changes.

why.en: Inspect this owner's App permission policy without inheriting the target's grants.

label.en: Show declared permissions, owner/App enablement, current daemon grants, unsupported direct-resource permissions, and pending/recent changes.

summary.en: Request restoration of a revoked, declared brokered permission. Returns pending, not granted. A human must use the OS approval gate or yu review; neither Settings GUI nor MCP can approve. Manifest/caller ceilings remain unchanged.

label.en: Why restoration is needed; not an approval.

why.en: Request trusted human restoration of this owner's declared App permission.

label.en: Request restoration of a revoked, declared brokered permission. Returns pending, not granted. A human must use the OS approval gate or yu review; neither Settings GUI nor MCP can approve. Manifest/caller ceilings remain unchanged.

summary.en: Revoke one declared brokered permission for this owner and target App. Invalidates that App's live daemon grants; restart/retry is required. Direct-resource permissions are rejected, never reported revoked.

why.en: Revoke only this owner's selected App permission, without a global owner/session wipe.

label.en: Revoke one declared brokered permission for this owner and target App. Invalidates that App's live daemon grants; restart/retry is required. Direct-resource permissions are rejected, never reported revoked.
